N_ios.text:
Sasa unaandika jibu mara moja tu, nalo linawafaa wote unaowaandikia. Cutling inaweza kuwa na nafasi tupu kwa sehemu inayobadilika, kama jina au nambari ya oda. Ukigusa cutling hiyo, kibodi ya Cutling inakuuliza jina na kukuonyesha majina uliyotumia awali, ili uchague moja kwa mguso mmoja tu. Kisha inaandika jibu zima. Unaweza pia kuandika jina kwanza, kisha ukagusa cutling.

Kuhusu tarehe, huna la kufanya. Cutling inaweza kubeba tarehe ya leo, ya kesho, ya wiki moja kutoka leo au saa, nayo hutoka sahihi siku unayoitumia. Pia inaweza kukupa machaguo (kwa mfano, kifurushi cha Msingi au cha Premium), kuleta maandishi uliyonakili mara ya mwisho, au kuacha kishale mahali unapotaka kuendelea kuandika. Yote haya yako kwenye kitufe cha “Vigezo” unapohariri cutling. Mabano mawimbi uliyoyaandika mwenyewe hubaki maandishi ya kawaida, kwa hiyo cutling ulizo nazo tayari zinafanya kazi kama zamani.

Unaweza kuandika cutling jinsi unavyoandika kwenye programu ya Notes ya Apple, bila kujifunza jambo jipya. Maandishi ya cutling sasa hufunguka kwenye ukurasa wake wenyewe, wenye herufi nzito, italiki, mstari wa chini, mstari wa kukata, kuangazia, herufi za upana sawa, viungo, na orodha za vitone, za vistari na za nambari.

Unaweza kuhifadhi mengi zaidi kuliko awali: cutling 5,000 za maandishi na picha 500, badala ya 100 na 25. Cutling moja inaweza kufika herufi 10,000, zinazotosha barua pepe nzima.

Kila kitufe kwenye kibodi ya Cutling sasa huandika. Ukigusa cutling yenye muundo, huandikwa kama nyingine yoyote. Ukiigusa na kuishikilia, hunakiliwa pamoja na muundo wake.

Ikiwa hukumaliza kuongeza kibodi ya Cutling, fungua “Kuweka kibodi” ndani ya Cutling. Mwongozo mpya unaonyesha hatua tatu za programu ya Mipangilio kwa video fupi.
N_ios.back:
Now you write a reply just one time, and it serves everyone you write to. A cutling can have an empty space for the part that changes, like a name or an order number. When you tap that cutling, the Cutling keyboard asks you the name and shows you the names you used before, so that you choose one with just one tap. Then it writes the whole reply. You can also write the name first, then tap the cutling.

As for dates, you have nothing to do. A cutling can carry today's date, tomorrow's, that of one week from today or the time, and it comes out correct on the day you use it. It can also give you choices (for example, the Basic bundle or the Premium one), bring in the text you copied last, or leave the cursor where you want to go on writing. All of these are at the “Variables” button when you edit a cutling. Curly braces you wrote yourself stay ordinary text, so the cutlings you already have work as before.

You can write a cutling the way you write in Apple's Notes app, without learning anything new. The cutling's text now opens on its own page, which has bold letters, italics, underline, strike-through line, highlighting, equal-width letters, links, and lists of bullets, of dashes and of numbers.

You can keep much more than before: 5,000 text cutlings and 500 images, instead of 100 and 25. One cutling can reach 10,000 characters, which are enough for a whole email.

Every key on the Cutling keyboard now writes. When you tap a cutling with formatting, it is written like any other. When you touch and hold it, it is copied together with its formatting.

If you did not finish adding the Cutling keyboard, open “Keyboard Setup” inside Cutling. The new guide shows the three steps of the Settings app by a short video.
N_ios.note: Second person singular with the ki- tense for 'when you' (ukigusa) and hu- for what habitually happens, as the app's Swahili strings write; 'cutling' takes class 9/10 agreement (cutling hiyo, cutling 5,000 za) as it does in the app. 'Everyone you send it to' is written 'wote unaowaandikia' (everyone you write to) because the verb for 'send to' is spelled the same as 'use'. A plan is 'kifurushi', the word East African phone users know plans by. Apple ships no Swahili interface, so Notes keeps its English name.

N_mac.text:
Sasa unaandika jibu mara moja tu, nalo linawafaa wote unaowaandikia. Cutling inaweza kuwa na nafasi tupu kwa sehemu inayobadilika, kama jina au nambari ya oda. Ukichagua cutling hiyo kwa ⌘⇧V, fomu fupi inakuuliza jina kabla ya kubandika, na majina uliyotumia awali unayapata kwa mbofyo mmoja.

Kuhusu tarehe, huna la kufanya: tarehe ya leo, ya kesho, ya wiki moja kutoka leo au saa hutoka sahihi siku unayotumia cutling. Cutling pia inaweza kukupa machaguo (kwa mfano, kifurushi cha Msingi au cha Premium) au kuleta maandishi uliyonakili mara ya mwisho. Yote haya yako kwenye kitufe cha “Ongeza kigezo”, kilicho chini tu ya maandishi unapohariri cutling. Mabano mawimbi uliyoyaandika mwenyewe hubaki maandishi ya kawaida, kwa hiyo cutling ulizo nazo tayari hubandikwa kama zamani.

Unaweza kuhifadhi mengi zaidi kuliko awali: cutling 5,000 za maandishi na picha 500, badala ya 100 na 25. Cutling moja inaweza kufika herufi 10,000, zinazotosha barua pepe nzima.
N_mac.back:
Now you write a reply just one time, and it serves everyone you write to. A cutling can have an empty space for the part that changes, like a name or an order number. When you choose that cutling with ⌘⇧V, a short form asks you the name before pasting, and the names you used before you get with one click.

As for dates, you have nothing to do: today's date, tomorrow's, that of one week from today or the time comes out correct on the day you use the cutling. A cutling can also give you choices (for example, the Basic bundle or the Premium one) or bring in the text you copied last. All of these are at the “Add Variable” button, which is just below the text when you edit a cutling. Curly braces you wrote yourself stay ordinary text, so the cutlings you already have are pasted as before.

You can keep much more than before: 5,000 text cutlings and 500 images, instead of 100 and 25. One cutling can reach 10,000 characters, which are enough for a whole email.
N_mac.note: Same voice as the iPhone text, with 'bofya/mbofyo' for click and 'bandika' for paste as the app's Mac strings have them.
